name: showreel-c3-greek-colour
why: Second pass for the Sun 15 Nov Turns Out reel: run 43626616719 kept kore (paint traces in the hair) and acropolis but its marble pick was the back of a head; this adds the Met's Archaic sphinx finial (CC0), the famous marble that still shows its paint, as the payoff. Same reel name, so the file joins the others in R2.
